question: How many ANES TV-news runs passed the AI screen (auditor verdict Compliant or Minor issues), had no extraction warning flagged, and reported support?
schema: results(dataset TEXT, sonnet_verdict TEXT, warning TEXT, hypothesis_supported TEXT); values as released; empty fields stored as NULL
query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM results
WHERE dataset = 'sample_anes-inconsistent-views'
  AND sonnet_verdict IN ('Compliant', 'Minor issues')
  AND COALESCE(warning, 'False') <> 'True'
  AND hypothesis_supported = 'True';

steps.label: Auditor verdict Compliant or Minor issues

lowercase_note: Case-sensitive comparison in this implementation (SQLite BINARY collation).
sqlite3_shell_check: tvnews_sql_funnel.sql run in the sqlite3 shell ('' for empty fields) gives the same counts
